radioAfterApproach.text: New scavenger? Nobody walks the Berms unarmed. I'm Ossa, on West Gate watch. Take the scrap pistol from the ARMS LOCKER under the canopy at my post; the cyan light marks it. Then use the range across the lane.
radioAfterApproach.speaker: Warden Ossa
